meta.interpretation: The user wants to see how participant enrollment is distributed across Phase 3 cancer (oncology) trials — i.e. the shape of the enrollment-size distribution, not a count by category.
assumptions: 'Oncology' was searched as the condition term 'cancer', which the API expands across neoplasm MeSH terms.
Limited to trials starting in 2015 or later, so the picture reflects contemporary Phase 3 practice rather than the full historical registry.
Restricted to interventional studies, since observational records do not carry a phase.
Enrollment mixes actual and estimated participant counts as reported by sponsors.
Log-scaled bins are used because enrollment is heavily right-skewed (a few very large trials would otherwise flatten the distribution).
meta.counting_semantics: Each trial falls in exactly one enrollment bin.
warnings: 123 trials fell outside the plotted range and were excluded from the bins.
Analyzed 5,000 of 5,720 matching trials (retrieval cap). Figures describe the analyzed subset; raise options.max_studies or narrow the filters for full coverage.
